relationships.subject: E153
relationships.evidence_quote: Further evaluation showed a very high affinity of E153 for the human sigma 1 receptor with IC50 of 2.4 nM

relationships.subject: E153
relationships.evidence_quote: E153 is a potent antagonist of histamine H3Rs antagonist [24].

relationships.subject: PRE-084
relationships.evidence_quote: The joint administration of PRE-084 at a dose of 15 mg/kg and E153 at the active dose of 5 mg/kg resulted in a significant decrease in E153 activity.

relationships.subject: E153
relationships.evidence_quote: It also showed a broad spectrum of antipruritic activity, attenuating histamine-dependent and histamine-independent itching.

key_findings: E153 binds sigma 1/2 receptors, crosses the blood-brain barrier and attenuates acute, inflammatory and neuropathic pain plus histamine-dependent and independent itch.
Analgesia depends on both sigma 1 and H3R antagonism; antipruritic effect depends mainly on sigma 1.
